title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: premium balance after remittances and refunds
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line fixes the premium balance a cover holder pays when settling the premium of a cover in full.

## Rule

1. The balance is the premium owed less the amounts of every premium remittance already applied to the cover and of every premium refund already booked on it.
2. The difference is rounded to the cent and is never below 0.00.

## Hypothetical worked examples

All figures are hypothetical.

| Premium owed | Remittances already applied | Refunds already booked | Balance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1,235.00 | 500.00 | 0.00 | 735.00 |
| 1,235.00 | 1,235.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 1,235.00 | 1,000.00 | 300.00 | 0.00 (the difference would be below 0.00) |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

- *Wrong reading:* only remittances reduce the balance. *Correct basis:* refunds already booked on the cover reduce it as well.
